instruction: Using GIMP, insert the subtitle 'Hello World' at the 3-second timestamp in the video located at /home/user/fullvideo.mp4.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot add time-synchronized subtitles to video files. While GIMP can add text to static images, it has no concept of video timelines, playback positions, or frame-accurate subtitle timing required for video subtitle editing.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP is an image editor and cannot handle video timelines or time-synchronized subtitles
The instruction requires video editing capabilities (adding subtitles at a specific timestamp) which GIMP fundamentally lacks
The infeasible() evaluator function is the semantically correct choice for this genuinely impossible task
Explanation in metadata accurately describes why the task cannot be completed
